title: Merge sort: sort halves, then merge

steps.caption: Merge sort: split in half until pieces have one element (already sorted), then merge sorted pieces back together.
Merge [38] and [27]: repeatedly take the smaller front element. 2 elements, 2 steps.
Merge [43] and [3]: repeatedly take the smaller front element. 2 elements, 2 steps.
Merge [27, 38] and [3, 43]: repeatedly take the smaller front element. 4 elements, 4 steps.
Merge [9] and [82]: repeatedly take the smaller front element. 2 elements, 2 steps.
Merge [10] and [5]: repeatedly take the smaller front element. 2 elements, 2 steps.
Merge [9, 82] and [5, 10]: repeatedly take the smaller front element. 4 elements, 4 steps.
Merge [3, 27, 38, 43] and [5, 9, 10, 82]: repeatedly take the smaller front element. 8 elements, 8 steps.
log₂(8) = 3 levels of merging, each level touches all n elements: O(n log n), every time.
